To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we identified the short arm of Y chromosome by cytological and molecular analyses in a 17- year-old male patient.
the karyotype of a patient was 46,X,i (Yp) and the marker chromosome was of Y origin and corresponded to an authentic isochrome for the short arm.
we have detected the presence of i(Yp) in a 17year-old male patient with shortening of the leg, breast development, pubic, axillary and facial hair development and small penis and testicle.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of an i(Yp) chromosome in an adolescent male patient.
the detection of the short arm isochromosome Y in a male patient.
the identification of an isochromosome for short arm of the chromosome Y, a rare chromosome anomaly.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the patient is a male with a 45,XY cell line and an additional i(Yp).
this patient should be classified as a male with an isodicentric Y chromosome.
the patient is a male.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the presence of the isochromosome Y is associated with a broad spectrum of disorders and the presence of the i(Yp) is associated with the development of male sexual organs and a normal male phenotype.
the presence of the Y chromosome in a male patient with 46,X,+i(Yp)/46,XY karyotype is a good prognosis for fertility.
the isochromosome Yp was a de novo mutation, which occurred during the first mitotic division of a normal 46,XY zygote.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the molecular analysis of the Y chromosome can be a useful tool in the diagnosis of the Y chromosome anomalies and in the determination of the sex of the patient.
the presence of the Yp arm of the Ychromosome is a marker of the male phenotype and is associated with the presence of the testes.
the molecular analysis by PCR is a very useful technique for the identification of the Y chromosome.
